modules.text:
An AI agent framework for orchestrating large language models with multi-step planning, tool use, and memory.

Designed with production constraints in mind: clear interfaces, failure handling, and predictable execution.

modules.title: Architecture & Design
modules.text:
The framework integrates model providers with tool execution, memory management, and planning loops.

Supports multi-turn conversations, structured outputs, and task decomposition.

Built to be extensible so new tools and skills can be added without changing the core runtime.

modules.title: Key Capabilities
modules.text:
Multi-step planning, dynamic tool selection, and context management across conversations.

Includes guardrails for malformed outputs, retries, and graceful degradation. The agent can plan, execute, and adapt based on outcomes.

modules.title: Production Features
modules.text:
Robust error handling, automatic retries, and basic rate limiting patterns.

Includes logging hooks and observability-friendly events so the runtime can be monitored in production.
